# BoredMutant

> BoredMutant builds custom software that companies own instead of rent: workflow automations, AI agents, team software and knowledge bases that replace SaaS subscriptions. Engineers audit a company's tools, replace the ones that bend its process with one owned system on its own stack, then run it for a flat monthly fee. For US companies of 50 to 500 people.

Canonical URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/
Book a call: https://cal.com/boredmutant/automations
Email: pranith@boredmutant.com
Full page text: https://www.boredmutant.com/llms-full.txt

## How an engagement runs

- Audit, 2 weeks, fixed fee: list every tool, seat and the job it does; time the work; write a fixed-price spec with the payback. The client keeps the spec.
- Replace, 3 to 6 weeks, fixed price: build on the client's stack, test on past cases beside the old tools, move the data, cancel the replaced seats.
- Run, monthly, flat fee: monitor, fix, improve, report against week one. The client can stop any month.

## Ownership terms

- The code lives in the client's repository from the first commit.
- It runs in the client's cloud accounts.
- Client data stays in client systems and trains nothing.
- No per-seat pricing.
- No lock-in: on exit the client keeps everything, with a runbook.

## What it builds

- Workflow automation between the systems a company keeps.
- AI agents that draft work for a person to approve.
- Team software shaped around one team's records, statuses and approvals.
- A knowledge base whose answers cite the source document and section.
